cards.title: Gimli
cards.subtitle: Skilled Defender
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Valiant. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion assigned to skirmish an unbound companion.
cards.lore: Despite Théoden's preparations, Gimli found it necessary to warn him of the advancing Uruk army.

cards.title: Balglin
cards.subtitle: Elven Warrior
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While skirmishing a wounded minion, Balglin takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.
cards.lore: He is a strong fighter. He asks for no quarter and gives none.

cards.title: Taurnil
cards.subtitle: Sharp-eyed Bowman
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Taurnil bears a ranged weapon, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +2, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.
cards.lore: Taurnil's careful aim can disarm his enemies at long range.

cards.title: Foul Horde
cards.gameText: Warg-rider. While Foul Horde is not exhausted, it is fierce. While Foul Horde has at least 3 vitality, it is ambush (1). While Foul Horde has at least 4 vitality, it is damage +1.

cards.title: Grima
cards.subtitle: Chief Counselor
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Grima to hinder a condition borne by an unbound companion (or hinder a companion and all Free Peoples cards they bear if you can spot 4 Free Peoples cultures).
cards.lore: “‘I care for you and yours as best I may.... Let others deal with these irksome guests.'”

cards.title: Scaling Ladder
cards.gameText: Machine. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [ISENGARD] token here (limit 2 per phase). Skirmish: For each [ISENGARD] token here, heal an Uruk-hai. Discard this condition.
cards.lore: “Hundreds of long ladders were lifted up. Many were cast down in ruin, but many more replaced them....”

cards.title: Let Us Be Swift
cards.gameText: Spot 3 valiant companions to discard up to 2 conditions and liberate a site.
cards.lore: “‘Let us drive through such foes as are already between us and the fastness.'”

cards.title: No Rest for the Weary
cards.gameText: Spot 3 valiant companions to make one of those companions defender +1 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘We must draw all our forces now behind the walls.'”

cards.title: Sigewulf
cards.subtitle: Brave Volunteer
cards.gameText: Villager. Regroup: Exert Sigewulf and spot 5 valiant companions to discard a minion.
cards.lore: The courage of Sigewulf and other Rohirrim like him will not be forgotten.

cards.title: Legolas
cards.subtitle: Archer of Mirkwood
cards.gameText: Archer. Valiant. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a Dwarf companion or another Elf companion.
cards.lore: “‘...even more would I give for a hundred good archers of Mirkwood. We shall need them.'”
